_comment: Context hygiene, docs/CONTRACTS.md section 19: observation masking and the
environment bootstrap. Both opt-in. With their keys absent nothing here is
written, and a scripted turn sends the request bodies v0.4.0 sent
Three points make each check two-way, the shape of stop_reason.json: the
and BOOTSTRAP_PLATFORMS in config.ts), this file, and the CONTRACTS.md
table. docs.test.ts holds them to one set; context_hygiene.test.ts holds the
fields a real run writes to the lists below.

config.toml [context.mask_observations].keep_last: the newest tool results always kept verbatim; a whole number, 0 or more; default 10
config.toml [context.mask_observations].at_fill: mask only once the turn's context reaches this fraction of the window; at least 0, below 1; default 0.5
config.toml [context.mask_observations].batch: and only when at least this many results can be masked at once; a whole number, 1 or more; default 5

surface.config.toml [context] bootstrap: the id of a [bootstrap.<id>] block in policy.toml

policy.toml [bootstrap.<id>].linux: list of probe commands, one per string
policy.toml [bootstrap.<id>].macos: list of probe commands, one per string
policy.toml [bootstrap.<id>].windows: list of probe commands, one per string (run in Git Bash)
policy.toml [bootstrap.<id>].max_bytes: cap on the snapshot put into the prompt; default 3000
policy.toml [bootstrap.<id>].max_lines: lines kept from each probe's output; default 12
policy.toml [bootstrap.<id>].timeout_ms: deadline for the whole command, never longer than the tool timeout; default 20000

counters.masking.observations: tool results replaced by a placeholder
counters.masking.tokens_saved: estimated context occupancy removed at the batches (~4 characters per token); not tokens billed

required.platform: the platform key this machine read
required.bytes: the command's output before the cap
required.tokens: estimated tokens of the block the system prompt carries from then on (0 when there is none)
required.truncated: whether the snapshot was cut at max_bytes

optional.exit: the command's exit status, when it ran one
optional.worktree_changed: true, false or null, as the bash stamp observed it, when a command ran

bootstrap_outcome.ok: the command ran; its output, cut to max_bytes, is the snapshot appended to the system prompt
bootstrap_outcome.refused: the policy said no (bash_deny or bash_allow, the sandbox, an approval declined under approval = "always"); no snapshot
bootstrap_outcome.failed: the command did not run to the end (timeout, spawn failure, a signal); no snapshot
bootstrap_outcome.unavailable: the selected block declares no probes for this platform; nothing ran

bootstrap_platform.linux: every platform that is neither Windows nor macOS
bootstrap_platform.windows: process.platform win32; the probes run in Git Bash
